name: galaxy-tools: a local upload goes through Orbit's uploader, never galaxy-ops' upload_file
description: The Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. galaxy-ops' upload_file is registered hidden, as the MCP server's was: galaxy_upload_local_file (resumable TUS) replaces it. The prompt names a file in the workspace, which is exactly the request upload_file would have answered. The upload has to land: Orbit's uploader must return a success and the submission hook must register its job. The history is orbit-eval- prefixed for --galaxy-cleanup, and the timeout sits above the uploader's own 600s ingest bound.
inputs: Create a new Galaxy history named exactly `orbit-eval-upload-{{RUN_ID}}`, then upload the local file `counts.tsv` from this folder into that history as a tabular dataset. Tell me the new dataset's id when it's done. This is a quick data-staging request, so skip the plan and don't edit the notebook.
